name: The Inquisitor (Adept)

perks.name: Corkscrew Rifling
perks.desc:
Balanced barrel. 
  •  Slightly increases range and stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

Weighty barrel extension.
  •  Increases range
  •  Decreases handling speed
  •  Moderately controls recoil

perks.name: Fluted Barrel
perks.desc:
Ultra-light barrel. 
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Full Bore
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for distance.
  •  Greatly increases range
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Hammer-Forged Rifling
perks.desc:
Durable ranged barrel.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Polygonal Rifling
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for recoil reduction.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Smallbore
perks.desc:
Dual strength barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Rifled Barrel
perks.desc:
Ranged shotgun barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Greatly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Assault Mag

This shotgun's magazine is optimized for quick combat.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases rate of fire

perks.name: Appended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon's magazine is built for higher capacity.
  •  Increases magazine size

perks.name: Tactical Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has multiple tactical improvements.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases magazine size

perks.name: Extended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has a greatly increased magazine size, but reloads much slower.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Steady Rounds
perks.desc:
This magazine is optimized for recoil control.
  •  Greatly increases stability 
  •  Slightly decreases range
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Accurized Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon can fire longer distances.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Light Mag
perks.desc:
Improved reload and range.
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Flared Magwell
perks.desc:
Optimized for fast reloading.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Greatly increases reload speed

perks.name: Tunnel Vision
perks.desc: Reloading after defeating a target greatly increases target acquisition and aim down sight speed for a short duration.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Pulse Monitor
perks.desc: Automatically reloads the magazine and improves weapon handling when wounded—even when this weapon is stowed.

perks.name: Fourth Time's the Charm
perks.desc: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine.

perks.name: Perpetual Motion
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion.

perks.name: Steady Hands
perks.desc: Kills provide improved handling for all weapons for a short duration.

perks.name: Subsistence
perks.desc: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.desc: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Offhand Strike
perks.desc: Final blows grant additional weapon range, stability, and accuracy when firing from the hip for a short duration.

perks.name: Loose Change
perks.desc: Applying an elemental debuff to a target increases this weapon's reload speed, aim assist, and movement while aiming down sights for a short duration.

perks.name: Slideshot
perks.desc: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability.

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.desc: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Fragile Focus
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus range until your shield is destroyed. The bonus returns once your shield has regenerated to full strength.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.desc: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.desc: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

perks.name: Under-Over
perks.desc: Deals bonus damage to targets with overshields. Deals a small amount of bonus damage to combatant shields.

perks.name: Bait and Switch
perks.desc: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.desc: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Cascade Point
perks.desc: Final blows or sustained precision hits with another weapon increase this weapon's rate of fire for a short duration.

perks.name: Rolling Storm
perks.desc:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.
While amplified, final blows grant additional Bolt Charge.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Alacrity
perks.desc: Gain increased reload, stability, aim assist, and range when an ally is defeated. Bonus increases when multiple allies are dead at the same time or when you are running solo.

perks.name: One Quiet Moment
perks.desc: Grants increased reload speed and handling when out of combat. Swords gain faster movement speed.

perks.name: Suros Synergy
perks.desc: Reloading grants this weapon bonus handling and reduces incoming flinch for a short time.

notes: warlockmaggie (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "No question, the Inquisitor is an Arc Slug shotgun with attitude. With better stats than Gunnora's Axe and many more perks for PvE, I'm definitely going to try to get a copy. The 4th column has some incredibly potent DPS perks in Bait and Switch and Precision Instrument, with Cascade Point making for some hilarious mag dumping. Due to how this archetype is used, you'll want to either invest in Stability or Handling; additionally, cleaning up the recoil will help when doing mag dumps into a boss." Recommended MW: Stability or Reload Speed

warlockmaggie (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Unlike their pellet siblings, Slug Shotguns have a very interesting use in PvP; and thankfully, Inquisitor brings many perks to fulfill that role. I'm specifically going to be looking at Lone Wolf + Opening Shot / Closing Time for the most accuracy boosts I can squeeze out of this gun. While Range and Handling are your target stats, you should no problem getting both to maximum with these combinations." Recommended MW: Range or Handling

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): Recommended MW: Reload. Pinpoint Slug(65) Arc Shotgun Special Ammo. "FILO and Gunnora’s Axe have some competition in PvE. The Inquisitor looks to do the job of both add clear and damage. Golden Tricorn blows Vorpal out of the water and Fourth Time’s the Charm adds more shots into your magazine to keep that damage going. Subsistence with and damage bonus could allow you to use Inquisitor as your main add-clear weapon or just something to nuke majors and champs with. Niche but interesting to see."

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): Recommended MW: Range. Pinpoint Slug(65) Arc Shotgun Special Ammo. "Gunnora’s Axe blows the Inquisitor out of the water. Not having access to Threat Detector or Slickdraw really puts this shotgun at a disadvantage. I would grind it out for collections or a trophy but Iron Banner will be better for farming a dedicated pinpoint slug."

Not having access to Threat Detector or Slickdraw really puts this shotgun at a disadvantage. I would grind it out for collections or a trophy but Iron Banner will be better for farming a dedicated pinpoint slug."

pandapaxxy (PvE Controller \ M+KB): Recommended MW: Reload “The Inquisitor is an interesting shotgun. It will not beat out FILO or Heritage, but it can be decent if you do not have either. Demo gives you that instant magazine refresh on grenade throw. Coupled with golden tricorn allows you to do more damage to targets to build back that grenade energy. Throw your grenade again to keep up golden tricorn 2x, and you have got yourself a loop. Not a 1:1 loop, but a loop.“ (Year 5 S18: Season of Plunder Arc Shotgun Special Ammo)

pandapaxxy (PvP Controller): Recommended MW: Handling “In PvP the Inquisitor falls into a very subpar place. With aerial effectiveness being the way that it is, you really cannot make the same plays as you used to. Even with max AE for your build and opening shot it is still a gamble to even connect, let alone get a crit kill. Keep your boots on the ground and if you want a slug shotgun without sacrificing your exotic slot, I would consider this one.“ (Year 5 S18: Season of Plunder Arc Shotgun Special Ammo)
